# ADR-XXXX — Decision

Choose next unused number from index; replace title/date/links. Keep status proposed until Simon explicitly accepts.

## Context and authority

Link confirmed constraints, affected PRD/architecture/policy and current primary evidence.

## Options

Compare real viable alternatives, benefit/cost/risk and reversibility; include rejected path and why.

## Proposed decision and rationale

Concrete boundary; what remains replaceable; what is excluded. Do not claim tests or approval.

## Consequences and validation

Affected docs/requirements, eval/RES/T/GATE IDs, pass/fail evidence, rollback and conditions for reconsideration.

## Decision authority and history

Approver Simon; acceptance date/evidence pending. If superseding, link prior record and preserve reasoning. Update ADR index in same change.
